note: Cumulative national turnout published by the Central Elections Committee during election day (share of all eligible voters). The hourly figures are estimates, not counts: polling-station secretaries' reports weighted with a sample survey run by the CBS for the committee (stated on the 2021 and 2022 pages). 'final' is the official final turnout including double envelopes. The 22:00 estimate missed the final by up to 0.7 points (2022: 71.3% announced on the night, 70.63% final). Curated by hand from the CEC pages listed under 'sources' and per election under 'source'.
release_lag: Each figure is released 30–65 minutes after its cutoff (2022: the 19:00 figure was published at 19:30, Israel Hayom https://www.israelhayom.co.il/news/politics/article/13245058).

K20.note20: 18:00: the dedicated page https://www.gov.il/he/pages/voting-by-hour-20 prints 56.4% (and a final of 72.4%); the CEC history table (PercentTimes, also reproduced on the bechirot22/24 pages), the Jerusalem Post's live coverage of 17.3.2015 ('only 54.6% at 6 p.m.', https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Voter-turnout-at-10-am-higher-than-in-2013-election-394166) and the CEC's own April-2019 comparison (52.0%, 'down 2.6 from 2015') give 54.6%, which is kept here.

K25.note22: 71.3% (4,843,023 voters) was announced on election night and is kept as the 22:00 series value; the gov.il table's 22:00 row shows 70.6% / 4,794,593, equal to the final count ('official_22'). The gov.il page states the hourly figures were computed from a CBS sample survey. The 19:00 figure (62.5%, CBS sample stations only) was published for the first time in 2022, at about 19:30. Some English outlets misprinted the 10:00 count as 1,760,076; the official figure is 1,076,076.

arab_estimates.note: Not official. Estimates for Arab society published during election day 2022, attributed by the Times of Israel live blog to the aChord Center (Hebrew University): surveys at sampled polling stations plus a model built on past results; aChord said it was the first time such turnout surveys were published during a vote. Official final for Arab and Druze localities: 53.2%.

K25.source: aChord Center, Hebrew University (via Times of Israel live blog, 1.11.2022)

points_note.18:00: The Times of Israel entry attributes 30% to an unnamed 'research center'; a separate Times of Israel article attributes 30% to unofficial Channel 12 figures. Not confirmed as aChord's.

arab_estimates.verified: partial: values 14:00=17, 16:00=23, 20:00=44, projected 54, final 53.2 confirmed from Times of Israel summaries on 9.10.2026; the 18:00 point only as reported, not as aChord's

'final' values equal the official turnout in site/data/core.json. A maintainer should open the source pages from an unblocked connection before election day.
